import sympy as sp
v=sp.nsimplify(sp.simplify(sp.cos(sp.rad(29))**2+sp.cos(sp.rad(61))**2))
v=sp.N(sp.cos(sp.pi*29/180)**2+sp.cos(sp.pi*61/180)**2,30)
opts={'A':sp.sqrt(3)/2,'B':2,'C':0,'D':1}
assert abs(v-opts['D'])<1e-20
for k in 'ABC': assert abs(v-sp.N(opts[k]))>1e-6

import sympy as sp
x=sp.symbols('x',positive=True)
r=sp.cancel((x**2-9)/(x+3))
opts={'A':x-9,'B':x+3,'C':x-3,'D':sp.sqrt(x**2-9)}
assert sp.simplify(r-opts['C'])==0
for k in 'ABD': assert sp.simplify(r-opts[k])!=0

import sympy as sp
x=sp.symbols('x')
r=sp.cancel((x**3+15*x**2+75*x+125)/(x**2-25)*(x-5))
opts={'A':x**2+5*x+25,'B':x**2-25,'C':x**2+10*x+25,'D':x**2+25}
assert sp.expand(r-opts['C'])==0
for k in 'ABD': assert sp.expand(r-opts[k])!=0

from fractions import Fraction as F
cosec=F(5,3); sin=1/cosec; cos2=1-sin**2
tan2=sin**2/cos2; sec2=1/cos2; cot2=1/tan2
v=(sec2-1)*cot2*(1+cot2)
opts={'A':F(9,16),'B':F(25,9),'C':F(25,16),'D':F(4,5)}
assert v==opts['B']
for k in 'ACD': assert v!=opts[k]
